# deps: tools: up yq to v4.26.1

Pin `yq` (mikefarah's YAML/JSON/XML processor, kept in the Go toolset) at v4.26.1, following [#332](DOT-331.md) (v4.25.3). The tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v4.26.1 tag](https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/tag/v4.26.1).
